name: Sausage, Pepper & Rice Stew
method: Brown the sausages in the oil in a wide, deep pan, then lift them out and cut each into 3 or 4 chunks.
In the same pan, soften the chopped onion, celery and pepper with the garlic for about 8 minutes.
Stir in the rice, paprika and flour, then add the chopped chilli and tomatoes, the stock cube dissolved in 500ml hot water, and the vinegar. Return the sausage to the pan.
Cover and simmer for 20 to 25 minutes until the rice is tender and the sauce is thick, adding a splash of water if it catches.
Scatter over the sliced spring onions and serve.
